_doc: Game manifest: top-level metadata the engine pulls at boot. 'The Squeeze' is a gritty retail-management memoir set inside a fictional megastore chain (Wally's World). All content is drop-in JSON; the engine itself remains genre-neutral.
victoryLine: Shift complete. You held the line.
defeatLine: The night takes you. Clock out — the machine grinds on without you.
